review.official:
Initially a patient at
Rhodes Island
, Popukar requested and passed the trial to become an
Operator
for Rhodes Island. She was assigned to
Op Reserve Team A6
.
She possesses tremendous destructive power, becoming the team's heavy.

files.description:
Imaging test for this Operator showed blurry outline of internal organs with visible unusual dark spots. Unusually high concentration of Originium particles were present in her circulation, indicating signs of infection and confirming her as infected at this stage. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 3% 
Crystallization visible on surface of body, with many symptoms of Oripathy. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.2u/L 
Subject is currently stabilized, but regular observation and treatment are required.

A member of Reserve Op Team A6. Although not capable of complex reasoning, her infection bestowed on her an ability that made her a suitable Operator. 
The source of a lot of problems for Team A6, most of these are unintentional. Because of her sincerity, she is also the easiest to forgive.

Unlike most other members, Popukar was taken in by Dr. Kal'tsit personally.
 Dr. Kal'tsit did not explain why she made this choice, only saying Popukar would stay on as a full-time member of Rhodes Island. 
However, Dr. Ansel said that was the first time she had ever seen Dr. Kal'tsit visibly upset.

Although Popukar failed her Operator exam, she was allowed to work in logistics, rather than being cast out. 
And as it is so rare for an infection to make a patient stronger, even rarer to the extent of Popukar's infection, she is a very valuable case study.

Popukar has gradually become one of the mascots of Rhodes Island. After all, no one could hate such an energetic little cutie -- even if she occasionally engages in 'minor' vandalism. 
Moreover, since joining A6, she has a much bigger family. Their shenanigans are just part of the Rhodes Island color nowadays.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Ummm... Nice to see you again, Doctor. It makes me happy... hehe...

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, do you need a break? I made you some tea, and Miss Orchid made cookies. Here, hope you like them… And, umm... Cheer up!

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Why is everyone in Team A6 always fighting with each other...? If things keep going like this, we can't be a team anymore... Fighting is bad. I must make them understand!

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: The gear on my chainsaw is kinda loose, the one that makes the 'vrrrr' sound ... But I don't remember using it lately. Weird...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Doctor, is Team A6 getting along well...? That's really some good news. Peace is the best... As long as they don't fight, nothing will bother me while I stay with you…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I don't know why, but I sometimes get these gaps in my memory. Then when I ask my teammates in A6, they just smile and tell me nothing happened at all...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Um, Doc-Doctor, did I just pass out...? Um, why is everyone lying on the floor? Miss Catapult? Mr. Midnight? Mr. Spot? Why do you all have bruises on your face? And Miss Orchid too...

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I'm actually super strong? You say I lost control over my power, when I wanted to stop my friends from fighting each other? That's why I don't remember anything...? Okay, I think I get it! Umm... right, I will put my power to good use!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Aaaah! The cup! I didn't control my grip... Errmm... I'm in trouble when the Doctor wakes up...

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Popukar from Operation Reserve Team A6, reporting in. Um, my teammates in A6 are always arguing. I'm sure you worry about them, Doctor... But I know what to do...

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Umm, Doctor, is the girl in the video... me?

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: I'm so happy I don't even know what to say...! Thank you, Doctor...! Thank you so much!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: My name is Popukar... Nice to meet you...

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: B-But... I really don't know anything about tactics or strategies or anything…

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Miss Catapult, um, it's time to deploy!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Miss Orchid, don't worry... I'll be fine.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Errrmm...

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: I'm right here.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I want to stop this fight.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Please stop arguiiing!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Be good and don't move.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Chainsaw got mad…

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Mr. Midnight, come back here... Miss Orchid is staring at you…

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Can everyone have a good peaceful talk, now...?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor… Doctor…? Here, I made some tea. You must be tired.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: **A painful groan** I'm… injured…? It hurts…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Please don't leave me here alone...

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Aaaugh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor, headpats…

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor. I made some soft and chewy New Year's cakes at the cafeteria... They say my cakes are great. I'm strong, so I always pound the dough well! Hehe...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Doctor, are you getting along with everyone today...?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Happy birthday, Doctor. I never really celebrated birthdays before, but now that I'm at Rhodes Island, Orchid always lets me have extra snacks on them... Do you want any? I'll sneak some out for you. Others won't notice!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Will we all stay together if I'm a good kid, if I'm a little smarter? I want A6 to stay together like a family... Will you help me, Doctor?
